evidence_scope: native PHP 8.5.12 JSONL ↔ Rust in-memory continuation state machine; not WordPress and not PHP-Wasm

wasm.reason: This runner executes native PHP only. Fixed-artifact WASIX one-shot and interactive bridge results are recorded separately under wasm/.

known_limits: The PHP fixture is synthetic and does not bootstrap WordPress.

The throwable scenario retains the actual Throwable only in a request-local PHP table; its string handle maps to a local typed Rust handle and is not a cross-process PHP heap pointer or production authorization token.

No native PHP↔Wasm re-entry, Zend bridge, DB, Query, full WordPress bootstrap, or production worker transport was exercised. The callable API profile covers seven standard filter APIs and the isolated action_api profile covers seven action APIs using materialized POD arguments; direct PHP WP globals and object/reference/resource filter values remain outside those profiles.
